queries: SELECT (SELECT AVG(m) FROM (SELECT AVG(product_price) AS m FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number) t) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE invoice_number IN (SELECT invoice_number FROM Invoices)) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice

WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(l.product_price) AS mean_price, COUNT(l.order_item_id) AS item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) SELECT AVG(mean_price) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price, AVG(item_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice FROM per_invoice

SELECT AVG(t.avg_price) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price, AVG(t.item_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice FROM (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(l.product_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(l.order_item_id) AS item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) t

responses.sql: SELECT (SELECT AVG(m) FROM (SELECT AVG(product_price) AS m FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number) t) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE invoice_number IN (SELECT invoice_number FROM Invoices)) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice

assumptions.assumption: Every line item counts toward the line-item average, including those with a NULL product_price. Only the price mean ignores NULLs.
Invoices with no line items add zero to the line-item average. They are excluded from the price average because they have no mean.
The average of per-invoice means is unweighted: each invoice counts once, whatever its number of line items.

responses.sql: WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(l.product_price) AS mean_price, COUNT(l.order_item_id) AS item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) SELECT AVG(mean_price) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price, AVG(item_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice FROM per_invoice

assumptions.assumption: Each row in Invoice_Line_Items counts as one line item (count of rows, not summing the VARCHAR product_quantity).
Invoices with only NULL prices have a NULL mean and are skipped for the first average (AVG ignores NULLs) but still count in the line-item average with their actual row count.

responses.sql: SELECT AVG(t.avg_price) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price, AVG(t.item_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice FROM (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(l.product_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(l.order_item_id) AS item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) t

assumptions.assumption: Each row in Invoice_Line_Items is one line item. Invoices with no rows count as 0 line items. Invoices whose prices are all NULL give a NULL mean, so the outer AVG skips them for the price average. They still count in the line-item average.
